packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

Keep package.json's `engines.node` a bare major such as `26`. Railpack installs that major in production (#66), and CI's setup-node reads it (#79). Under the top-level rangeStrategy bump, Renovate rewrites the major to a full release (#70, 26 to 26.13.0) and would open a PR for every Node release. auto leaves `26` alone and still proposes the next major, as #64 did.

Group the Bun pin in package.json's `packageManager` with the fallback Dockerfile's `oven/bun` build and runtime tags, so one PR bumps all three and the Dockerfile builds on the Bun that CI and production run (#104). A unit test, scripts/bun-pins.test.ts, compares the two tags with `packageManager`, so CI fails while they differ. When npm lists a Bun release before Docker Hub does, the PR fails CI and waits until its tags match. The rule only groups: each upgrade keeps the automerge the rules above give it.
